Lina (devex): quick note from a user walkthrough: the Next starter's SDK example causes a retry storm when the sample API key rotates.
Ravi (eng-runtime): is this Edge or Node?
Lina (devex): Edge. first request gets 401, client retries immediately 3x and we hit rate limits.
Sophie (docs): users copy the snippet verbatim so we should fix the sample.
Ravi (eng-runtime): plan: change sample to show `retries: 1` and `onAuthRefresh` hook. add a helper util `lib/withAuthRefresh.js`.
Lina (devex): can we add a short eval test that simulates token expiry and asserts exactly one refresh attempt?
Infra-bot: scheduled pipeline job `samples-next:auth-refresh-check` for PRs.
Sophie (docs): I'll update the README and quickstart note about Edge token refresh semantics.
Ravi (eng-runtime): also adding a runtime issue (#2468) to standardize SDK defaults for edge contexts.
Lina (devex): thanks — opening the PR now and will link when ready. :sparkles:
